Sana Patel  
Toronto, Ontario | +1 (416) 555-0199 | sana.patel@email.com | linkedin.com/in/sanapatel  

A results-oriented DevOps/SRE consultant with a decade of experience driving scalable cloud infrastructure, automation, and system reliability. Specialized in architecting robust solutions across hybrid environments, mentoring teams, and delivering measurable improvements in system uptime and operational efficiency.  

**Professional Experience**  
*Staff DevOps/SRE Consultant*  
CloudOps Solutions | 2023–Present  
Led end-to-end DevOps transformation for a mid-sized SaaS provider, reducing deployment cycles by 40% through optimized CI/CD pipelines and integrated monitoring. Designed scalable Kubernetes clusters on GCP, supporting 15+ microservices with 99.95% SLA compliance. Mentored junior engineers in Terraform practices, standardizing infrastructure-as-code across three teams.  

*Senior DevOps Engineer*  
DataFlow SaaS | 2019–2023  
Architected and maintained a high-availability PostgreSQL cluster for real-time analytics, achieving 99.98% uptime and 30% latency reduction through query optimization and replication strategies. Spearheaded the migration of legacy systems to AWS, improving resource utilization by 25% and reducing costs by $120K annually.  

*Site Reliability Engineer*  
CloudScale Services | 2016–2019  
Developed and maintained REST APIs for internal tooling, streamlining incident response and automation workflows. Implemented Redis-based caching layers for critical applications, decreasing read latency by 50% and improving user engagement metrics.  

*DevOps Engineer*  
TechNova Startups | 2013–2016  
Built and deployed CI/CD pipelines for multiple SaaS products, achieving 95% first-time deployment success rates. Integrated message queues (Kafka/RabbitMQ) into core systems, enabling asynchronous processing and improving system responsiveness by 35%.  

**Technical Skills**  
- **GCP**: Architectured scalable cloud-native solutions, including Kubernetes clusters, managed databases, and load-balanced microservices.  
- **Kubernetes**: Designed and maintained production-grade clusters, automated rollouts, and implemented self-healing mechanisms for critical workloads.  
- **Linux administration**: Optimized system performance through kernel tuning, security hardening, and custom script automation for repetitive tasks.  
- **Terraform**: Standardized infrastructure-as-code practices, reducing environment setup time by 60% and minimizing human error in provisioning.  
- **CI/CD pipelines**: Engineered Jenkins-based pipelines with Python scripts for artifact promotion, achieving 98% deployment reliability across 10+ projects.  
- **Monitoring & alerting**: Built Prometheus/Grafana dashboards for real-time metrics, reducing mean time to resolution (MTTR) for critical alerts by 40%.  
- **AWS**: Led hybrid cloud strategy, designing fault-tolerant architectures with auto-scaling and multi-AZ deployments for mission-critical applications.  
- **PostgreSQL**: Optimized query performance and ensured high availability for analytics platforms, handling 10M+ transactions daily.  
- **Redis**: Integrated caching layers for low-latency applications, improving response times and reducing database load by 25%.  
- **Python**: Developed custom tools for log parsing, configuration management, and API testing, streamlining operations across teams.  
- **REST API design**: Created scalable APIs for internal and external integrations, enabling seamless data exchange between microservices.  

**Projects**  
- **Global Monitoring Dashboard**: Built a centralized observability platform using Prometheus, Grafana, and custom Python scripts, aggregating metrics from 50+ services.  
- **Kubernetes Auto-Scaling Optimization**: Reduced resource waste by 30% through dynamic scaling rules and cost-aware scheduling policies.  
- **Legacy System Modernization**: Migrated monolithic applications to containerized microservices, improving deployment speed and scalability.
